cnd1:1.1: Kosalānaṃ purā rammā agamā Dakkhiṇāpathaṃ ākiñcaññaṃ patthayāno brāhmaṇo mantapāragū.
cnd1:2.1: So Assakassa visaye Muḷakassa samāsane vasī Godhāvarīkūle uñchena ca phalena ca.
cnd1:3.1: Tass' eva upanissāya gāmo ca vipulo ahu, tato jātena āyena mahāyaññam akappayi,
cnd1:4.1: Mahāyaññaṃ yajitvāna puna pāvisi assamaṃ. Tasmiṃ patipaviṭṭhamhi añño āgañchi brāhmaṇo
cnd1:5.1: Ugghaṭṭapādo tasito paṅkadanto rajassiro, so ca naṃ upasaṅkamma satāni pañca yācati.
cnd1:6.1: Tam enaṃ Bāvarī disvā āsanena nimantayi, sukhañ ca kusalaṃ pucchi, idaṃ vacanam abravi:
cnd1:7.1: "Yaṃ kho mamaṃ deyyadhammaṃ sabbaṃ vissajjitam mayā, anujānāhi me brahme, n' atthi pañca satāni me."
cnd1:8.1: "Sace me yācamānassa bhavaṃ n' ānupadassati, sattame divase tuyhaṃ muddhā phalatu sattadhā."
cnd1:9.1: Abhisaṅkharitvā kuhako bheravaṃ so akittayi, tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā Bāvarī dukkhito ahu,
cnd1:10.1: Ussussati anāhāro sokasalla-samappito, atho pi evaṃ-cittassa jhāne na ramatī mano.
cnd1:11.1: Utrastaṃ dukkhitaṃ disvā devatā atthakāminī. Bāvariṃ upasaṅkamma idaṃ vacanam abravi:
cnd1:12.1: "Na so muddhaṃ pajānāti, kuhako so dhan' atthiko, muddhani muddhapāte vā ñāṇaṃ tassa na vijjati."
cnd1:13.1: "Bhotī carahi jānāti, tam me akkhāhi pucchitā muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca, taṃ suṇoma vaco tava."
cnd1:14.1: "Aham p' etaṃ na jānāmi, ñāṇam m' ettha na vijjati, muddhaṃ muddhādhipāto ca Jinānaṃ h' eta dassanaṃ."
cnd1:15.1: "Atha ko carahi jānāti asmiṃ puthavimaṇḍale muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca, tam me akkhāhi devate."
cnd1:16.1: "Purā Kapilavatthumhā nikkhanto lokanāyako apacco Okkākarājassa Sakyaputto pabhaṅkaro.
cnd1:17.1: So hi brāhmaṇa sambuddho sabbadhammānapāragū sabb' ābhiññā-balappatto sabba-dhammesu cakkhumā sabba-dhamma-kkhayaṃ patto vimutto upadhikkhaye,
cnd1:18.1: Buddho so Bhagavā loke dhammaṃ deseti cakkhumā taṃ tvaṃ gantvāna pucchassu, so te taṃ byākarissati."
cnd1:19.1: ‘Sambuddho' ti vaco sutvā udaggo Bāvarī ahu, sok' assa tanuko āsi, pītiñ ca vipulaṃ labhi.
cnd1:20.1: So Bāvarī attamano udaggo taṃ devataṃ pucchati Vedajāto: "katamamhi gāme nigamamhi vā puna katamamhi vā janapade lokanātho, yattha gantvā namassemu Sambuddhaṃ dipa-duttamaṃ."
cnd1:21.1: "Sāvatthiyaṃ Kosalamandire Jino pahūta-pañño vara-bhūrimedhaso, so Sakyaputto vidhuro anāsavo muddhādhipātassa vidū narāsabho."
cnd1:22.1: Tato āmantayi sisse brāhmaṇe mantapārage: "etha māṇavā, akkhissaṃ, suṇotha vacanaṃ mama:
cnd1:23.1: Yass' eso dullabho loke pātubhāvo abhiṇhaso, sv-ajja lokamhi uppanno Sambuddho iti vissuto, khippaṃ gantvāna Sāvatthim passavho dipa-d-uttamaṃ."
cnd1:24.1: "Kathañ carahi jānemu disvā ‘Buddho' ti brāhmaṇa, ajānatan no pabrūhi, yathā jānemu taṃ mayaṃ."
cnd1:25.1: "Āgatāni hi mantesu mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇā dvattiṃsā ca byakkhātā samattā anupubbaso.
cnd1:26.1: Yass' ete honti gattesu mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇā, dve yeva tassa gatiyo, tatiyā hi na vijjati.
cnd1:27.1: Sace agāraṃ āvasati, vijeyya paṭhaviṃ imaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena-m-anusāsati;
cnd1:28.1: Sace ca so pabbajati agārā anagāriyaṃ, vivaṭa-cchado sambuddho arahā bhavati anuttaro.
cnd1:29.1: Jātiṃ gottañ ca lakkhaṇaṃ mante sisse pun' āpare muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca manasā yeva pucchatha.
cnd1:30.1: Anāvaraṇadassāvī yadi buddho bhavissati, manasā pucchite pañhe vācāya vissajessati."
cnd1:31.1: Bāvarissa vaco sutvā sissā solasa brāhmaṇā Ajito Tissa-Metteyyo Puṇṇako atha Mettagū.
cnd1:32.1: Dhotako Upasīvo ca Nando ca atha Hemako Todeyya-Kappā d' ubhayo Jatukaṇṇī ca paṇḍito
cnd1:33.1: Bhadrāvudho Udayo ca Posālo cā pi brāhmaṇo Mogharājā ca medhāvī Piṅgiyo ca mahā isi,
cnd1:34.1: Pacceka-gaṇino sabbe sabba-lokassa vissutā jhāyī jhānaratā dhīrā pubba-vāsana-vāsitā
cnd1:35.1: Bāvariṃ abhivādetvā katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ jaṭājinadharā sabbe pakkāmuṃ uttarāmukhā:
cnd1:36.1: Muḷakassa Patiṭṭhānaṃ purimaṃ Māhissatiṃ tadā Ujjeniñ c' āpi Gonaddhaṃ Vedisaṃ Vanasavhayaṃ,
cnd1:37.1: Kosambiṃ cā pi Sāketaṃ Sāvatthiñ ca pur' uttamaṃ Setabyaṃ Kapilavatthuṃ Kusinārañ ca mandiraṃ,
cnd1:38.1: Pāvañ ca Bhoganagaraṃ Vesāliṃ Māgadhaṃ puraṃ Pāsāṇakañ cetiyañ ca ramaṇīyaṃ manoramaṃ.
cnd1:39.1: Tasito v' udakaṃ sītaṃ mahālābhaṃ va vāṇijo chāyaṃ ghamm' ābhitatto va turitā pabbatam āruhuṃ,
cnd1:40.1: Bhagavā ca tamhi samaye bhikkhu-saṅgha-purakkhato bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, sīho va nadati vane.
cnd1:41.1: Ajito addasa Sambuddhaṃ vītaraṃsi va bhāṇumaṃ candaṃ yathā pannarase pāripūriṃ upāgataṃ.
cnd1:42.1: Ath' assa gatte disvāna paripūrañ ca byañjanaṃ ekamantaṃ ṭhito haṭṭho manopañhe apucchatha:
cnd1:43.1: "Ādissa jammanaṃ brūhi, gottaṃ brūhi salakkhaṇaṃ, mantesu pāramiṃ {brūhi}, kati vāceti brāhmaṇo."
cnd1:44.1: "Vīsaṃ-vassasataṃ āyu, so ca gottena Bāvari, tīṇ' assa lakkhaṇā gatte tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū.
cnd1:45.1: Lakkhaṇe itihāse ca sanighaṇḍu-sakeṭubhe, pañca satāni vāceti sadhamme pāramiṃ gato."
cnd1:46.1: Lakkhaṇānaṃ pavicayaṃ Bāvarissa nar' uttama taṇhacchida pakāsehi, mā no kaṅkhāyitaṃ ahu."
cnd1:47.1: "Mukhaṃ jivhāya chādeti, uṇṇ' assa bhamukantare, kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ: evaṃ jānāhi māṇava."
cnd1:48.1: Pucchaṃ hi kiñci asuṇanto sutvā pañhe viyākate vicinteti jano sabbo vedajāto katañjali:
cnd1:49.1: ‘Ko nu devo va Brahmā vā Indo vā pi Sujampati Manasā pucchi te pañhe, kam etaṃ paṭibhāsati.'
cnd1:50.1: "Muddhaṃ muddhādhipātañ ca Bāvarī paripucchati, taṃ byākarohi Bhagavā, kaṅkhaṃ vinaya no ise."
cnd1:51.1: "Avijjā muddhā ti jānāhi, vijjā muddhādhipātinī saddhā-sati-samādhīhi chanda-viriyena saṃyutā."
cnd1:52.1: Tato vedena mahatā santhambhitvāna māṇavo ekaṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā pādesu sirasā pati:
cnd1:53.1: "Bāvarī brāhmaṇo bhoto saha sissehi mārisa udaggacitto sumano pāde vandati cakkhuma."
cnd1:54.1: "Sukhito Bāvarī hotu saha sissehi brāhmaṇo, tvañ cā pi sukhito hohi, ciraṃ jīvāhi māṇava.
cnd1:55.1: Bāvarissa ca tuyhaṃ vā sabbesaṃ sabba-saṃsayaṃ kat' āvakāsā pucchavho, yam kiñci manas' icchatha."
cnd1:56.1: Sambuddhena kat' okāso nisīditvāna pañjalī Ajito paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ tattha pucchi Tathāgataṃ. VATTHUGĀTHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
